decision_time: recorded order_purchase_timestamp; original source-system event availability not independently attested
feature_source: All five deterministic calendar transforms of order_purchase_timestamp only; no promise, item, customer, seller, payment, shipment, delivery, review or status inputs
label_rule: Comparable delivered orders only: recorded delivered status, actual delivery >= purchase, promised calendar day >= purchase calendar day; actual delivery and end of promised day both strictly before phase cutoff. Late means actual delivery calendar date > estimated date. Unknown/cancelled/non-delivered/invalid or not yet mature excluded and counted, not negatives. Historical status and promise values are retrospective, not witnessed as-of snapshots.

calibrator.family: logistic regression on raw log odds

uncertainty.method: purchase-calendar-week cluster bootstrap of fixed-model diagnostic predictions; conditional on fitted model, not prospective significance

holdout.reason: All archived Olist opportunities were included in previous source-wide outcome reconciliation; later periods repeatedly inspected. No independently documented unseen cohort or external holdout supplied.
